answer: Mechanism: differential propagation attestation (DPA). Each identity periodically submits time-difference-of-arrival fingerprints from three independent beacon chains at an inlet, a gale-exposed ridge, and a canyon wall. Signed chirps and a sub-millisecond window force the agent’s radio tag to measure real multipath and clock drift. A single operator cannot fabricate many valid fingerprints without placing and powering separate tags at separated sites. Cost: one tag, site access, power, and upkeep per identity.
